scope: One event queue and projectile identity sequence for both arena teams; retained team rule-order views; Blood Craze, Blessed Recovery and Lightwell use persistent scheduled healing.

regression.after: All three dedicated tests pass as part of periodic-events and gameplay suites; opposing-team damage also has a dedicated arena test.

comparison.scope: Arena queue migration, captured after the talent registration fix
comparison.normalization: Arena projectile storage is combined and sorted by launch time/caster/spell; objects carrying landsAt and actorId exclude id/sequence/teamId. Other fields are compared without normalization.
comparison.result: All remaining fields match, including RNG, health/resources, action counts, logs, deaths and assets

behaviorChanges: Previously unscheduled talent recovery effects now pulse and restore correctly
Arena projectiles and scheduled subject IDs are unique across the entire match
Projectile ready records route by originating team even after their launcher disappears
Channel shortening resolves only against the current instance; the old global channel-owner map is removed
limitations: Arena still uses alternating team rule views and team ground-effect lists; permanent/runtime entity separation remains incomplete
Battleground simplified combat still needs consolidation
Enemy periodic auras, ground effects, global regeneration and boss timers remain to migrate
Outer 100ms rule progression and AI observation scans remain
Latest ruleset has not undergone the complete browser quest/dungeon/Onyxia matrix
Benchmark is local rules/IPC only, with no PostgreSQL, WebSocket or target-server capacity conclusion
